rounds.explain: Plane mirror images are virtual, erect and the same size.

rounds.prompt: You stand 2 m from a mirror. Your image is…
rounds.explain: Same distance behind as the object is in front.

rounds.prompt: Match each property to the plane mirror image.
rounds.explain: Same size, laterally inverted, virtual and erect.
